result.instructions: Tools for TourCMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tours have space next Saturday for four people?"; "Show me the bookings made this week and their payment status."; "List the departures for today with their spaces left.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TourCMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tourcms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tourcms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tourcms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tourcms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tourcms_check_rate_limit
tools.title: Check rate limit
tools.description: Show how many GET and POST calls this channel can still make in the current hour (TourCMS allows 3000 of each per hour). Also confirms the channel ID and API key work. GET /api/rate_limit_status.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_channel
tools.title: Show channel
tools.description: Show this channel's details: name, website, and contact information. GET /c/channel/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_search_tours
tools.title: Search tours
tools.description: Search this channel's tours by keyword, distance, month, or location, with paging. Use it to list products or find one. GET /c/tours/search.xml.

filters.description: Filters as a URL query string, for example `k=rafting&order=price_down`. Use only the filters the TourCMS method lists.

tools.name: tourcms_list_tours
tools.title: List tours
tools.description: List all tours of this channel without paging. Returns less data than search, so it suits exports. GET /c/tours/list.xml.

filters.description: Filters as a URL query string, for example `active=1`. Use only the filters the TourCMS method lists.

tools.name: tourcms_show_tour
tools.title: Show tour
tools.description: Show the full details of one tour: descriptions, rates, options, and images. GET /c/tour/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_tour_dates
tools.title: Show tour dates and deals
tools.description: Show the dates, prices, and special offers of one tour. GET /c/tour/datesprices/datesndeals/search.xml.

filters.description: Filters as a URL query string, for example `distinct_start_dates=1`. Use only the filters the TourCMS method lists.

tools.name: tourcms_check_tour_availability
tools.title: Check tour availability
tools.description: Check whether one tour has space on a date for a number of people per rate (rate IDs such as r1 come from Show Tour). GET /c/tour/datesprices/checkavail.xml.

filters.description: Filters as a URL query string, for example `date=2026-08-01&r1=2`. Use only the filters the TourCMS method lists.

tools.name: tourcms_list_departures
tools.title: List departures
tools.description: List the departures of all tours for one date, for staff views such as a daily sheet. GET /c/tour/datesprices/dep/manage/overview.xml.

date.description: Departure date, yyyy-mm-dd. Leave empty to let TourCMS choose the date.

tools.name: tourcms_show_departure
tools.title: Show departure
tools.description: Show one departure of a tour: date, spaces, prices, and special offer. For staff, not for customers. GET /c/tour/datesprices/dep/manage/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_search_bookings
tools.title: Search bookings
tools.description: Search this channel's bookings, for example active bookings or bookings made in a period. Contains customer data. GET /c/bookings/search.xml.

filters.description: Filters as a URL query string, for example `active=1&made_date_start=2026-01-01&made_date_end=2026-01-31`. Use only the filters the TourCMS method lists.

tools.name: tourcms_show_booking
tools.title: Show booking
tools.description: Show one booking with its components, customer, payments, and notes. Contains customer data. GET /c/booking/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded in a period, for reconciliation. GET /c/booking/payment/list.xml.

filters.description: Filters as a URL query string, for example `from_date=2026-03-01&to_date=2026-03-31`. Use only the filters the TourCMS method lists.

tools.name: tourcms_add_booking_note
tools.title: Add booking note
tools.description: Add a note to an existing booking of this channel, for example a customer request or an audit line. It does not change the booking. POST /c/booking/note/new.xml.

note.description: Free text to store on the booking.

note_type.description: Note type as configured in TourCMS, for example AUDIT.

tools.name: tourcms_search_enquiries
tools.title: Search enquiries
tools.description: Search this channel's enquiries, for example enquiries made in a period. Contains customer data. GET /c/enquiries/search.xml.

filters.description: Filters as a URL query string, for example `made_date_start=2026-04-01&made_date_end=2026-04-30`. Use only the filters the TourCMS method lists.

tools.name: tourcms_show_customer
tools.title: Show customer
tools.description: Show one customer record: name, contact details, and address. Contains personal data. GET /c/customer/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_list_staff
tools.title: List staff members
tools.description: List the staff members who have logins on this channel. GET /c/staff/list.xml.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with TourCMS
prompts.description: What you can do with TourCMS here, with example requests to try.
